title: unified-rollouts-probing-quarantine-autorollback-enhancements
author: Priya Natarajan
release_notes: Enhances probing/quarantine autorollback workflow: adds metric quorum, preflight probing, additional safety guards, expanded observability and e2e tests. No breaking API changes.
description:
Summary: Improve the unified-rollouts automated rollback workflow by adding a probing+quarantine stage with metric quorum, preflight checks, and stronger observability and safety guards. Motivation: recent incidents showed edge cases where transient degradations caused premature rollbacks or missed regressions because single-metric signals were noisy and preflight checks were insufficient. This PR introduces a staged probing phase that quarantines suspicious traffic, waits for metric quorum across signal groups, and runs preflight e2e probes before completing a rollout.

What this changes (high level):
- Add 'probing' stage to rollout state machine (staged shadow/canary path).
- Implement metric quorum logic: requires majority agreement across latency/error/quality signal groups before autorollback triggers.
- Quarantine flow: suspicious requests are split to a quarantine bucket and proxied to the candidate model for more intensive telemetry collection.
- Preflight probe harness: run synthetic request sets (from eval registry) against candidate; failures block promotion.
- Observability: new Prometheus metrics (rollout_probe_*, quarantine_rate), tracing spans for probing/quarantine decisions, and dashboard panels.
- E2E/integration tests: add harness that simulates noisy signals and ensures quorum prevents flapping.
- Docs: rollout runbook and config examples for policy authors.

Checklist:
- [x] Design doc (ENG-3456) linked
- [x] Unit tests for quorum evaluator
- [x] Integration tests for quarantine flow
- [x] e2e stability tests added
- [x] Dashboard + alerts updated
- [x] Backwards compatible (config defaults preserve current behavior)

Commits (summary):
- 9 commits, squashed on merge:
  - add probing stage state machine and handlers
  - implement metric quorum evaluator with signal grouping
  - quarantine router + proxy adjustments
  - add preflight probe harness + eval registry integration
  - prometheus metrics and tracing spans
  - add e2e tests and CI job
  - docs and rollout runbook

Files changed (high level):
- rollout/state_machine.go (probing + quarantine states)
- rollout/quorum_evaluator.go (new evaluator logic)
- router/quarantine_proxy.go (quarantine routing)
- probes/preflight_harness.go (preflight probe runner)
- telemetry/metrics.yaml (new metrics)
- telemetry/tracing_instrumentation.go
- integration/e2e/probing_quarantine_test.go
- docs/runbooks/rollouts.md
- tests/fixtures/probes/* (synthetic probe sets)

Review conversation (high level):
- Aisha Khan (reviewer): "Nice clean separation of concerns. Two high-level asks: (1) make quorum thresholds configurable per team and (2) add a guard to avoid runaway quarantine traffic in high-rps tenants."
- Author (Priya): "Both addressed: thresholds are now policy-level with sane defaults; added backpressure limiter and circuit-breaker on quarantine percentage (configurable max_quarantine_pct)."
- Oliver Grant (reviewer): "Can we avoid blocking rollout creation on probe registry availability? Suggested adding fallback cached probe sets."
- Author (Priya): "Added local probe cache and a best-effort mode that uses cached probes if registry calls fail; documented behavior in runbook."
- Samantha Li (approver): "Integration tests are solid. Approving after CI green."

CI and gating: initial pipeline had 2 flaky e2e failures on a race in the probe harness; fixed test ordering and added retries. Final CI: all checks passed. CI details: unit tests (pass), integration (pass after rerun), e2e (pass), lint (pass), build (pass).

Backward compatibility and config: defaults preserve previous rollout policy (no probing/quarantine unless policy includes probing: true). Policy authoring docs include examples and recommended thresholds.

Merging: Squash-merged into main after approvals. Rollout exposure gated behind feature flag rollout.probing_quarantine (defaults to off). Post-merge, we scheduled gradual enabling for internal staging teams and a 2-week monitoring window before wider rollout.

Notes for operators:
- Dashboard: Rollouts -> Probing tab (new) shows current quarantine rates and probe results.
- Alerts: Created alert RL-QuarantineHighPct (fires when quarantine_pct > configured threshold for >5m).
- If you observe large quarantine percentages, toggle feature flag or reduce sensitivity in policy until investigation completes.

Related: ENG-3456 (design), ENG-3490 (e2e stability), SUP-1221 (support ticket that motivated conservative default).
